description: D05 sqrt(s)=1000 GeV, existing artifacts, one caller worker per process, paired native QMC points across prescriptions; no regeneration or new discrete-MC study. Separate from historical 50-core, 300-second benchmarks.

native_layout.covariance: Flat row-major native covariance of the complete Laurent-vector mean. Sector marginal variances must not be summed as total variance because shifts are shared.

provenance.test_source_scope: The build receipt inventories tests.rs, but the production binary excludes cfg(test). The later test-only runtime-parameter declaration fixed the focused regression fixture; it did not change this production executable.
provenance.core_source_scope: frozen cache milestone before concurrent generation selection edits; no current-core-build claim

tuning.scope: SelectedSectors [0,3,6,11,26,28,29], ExcludeAll exact, one reused paired tuning seed; no full-integral claim.
tuning.selection_note: The same candidate minimizes equal-point finite variance, variance times native evaluation, and variance times sampling with hash/top timing removed. Selection frozen before the fresh full-integral seeds.

diagnostic_replay.scope: Native replay of the union of recorded high-weight points. Base-chart H partition is diagnostic, not identification of endpoint-face callbacks or a cube-wide causal certificate. All extrema below concern this recorded union only.

confirmation.scope: FullIntegral, all 30 residual sectors, native aggregate exact contribution once, separate independent seeds; no estimator pooling.
confirmation.statistical_limit: Eight complete native shared shifts per estimate; two independent seeds reported separately. Observed variance and cost ratios are noisy and do not prove target accuracy or a uniform efficiency gain.

cost_definitions.adjusted_sampling: Adjusted sampling subtracts measured coordinate-hash and top-point-selection timers from complete native-session elapsed, retaining context setup and scheduling. Native evaluation is the outer rescue-inclusive weighted batch timer. Domain sector counters are separately reported; no timing subtraction changes any native estimate.
cost_definitions.per_sector: Per-sector sum of native f64, double-float, arbitrary and conditioning evaluator timing counters divided by completed physical points. Includes rescue evaluation time; excludes hashing, top selection, setup and pilot. This is max sector mean cost, not maximum individual-call latency. The outer native_evaluation_seconds additionally includes batch validation and dispatch overhead.
cost_definitions.whole_process_rss: Sampled process-group peaks include native artifact restoration and pilot; batch aggregate includes supervisor and concurrent children.

failures_and_censoring.initial_setup_failure_reason: Parameterized native exact coefficients were unbound before scope construction; failure occurred before QMC allocation. Corrected by binding before canonical scope and covered by a focused indexed regression. Both original receipts retained.
failures_and_censoring.note: All completed corrected scout/followup/confirmation arms admitted and completed. Very large high-cap variances are retained, not discarded.

limitations: This short matched-work QMC study does not establish per-mille accuracy.
Only eight shifts and two independent confirmation seeds; estimated variance/cost ratios are noisy.
Selected dynamic variance improves in both seeds, but adjusted variance-times-cost is slightly worse than fixed in one seed; no uniform efficiency gain claimed.
Production saved evaluators remain Horner 0. Diagnostic-only H partition evaluators use the new Horner 10 default.
Root diagnostic callback ranges include faces and precision retries; base-chart lambda is reported separately.
